name: Uplinks and High-Power Amplifiers Architecture
description: Examination of the architectural role of uplinks and the definition of Output Back-Off (OBO) in High-Power Amplifiers within satellite communication systems.
learning_objectives: Examine the architectural role of uplinks in satellite communication
Define Output Back-Off (OBO) in High-Power Amplifiers
common_pitfalls: Confusing uplink architecture with downlink processing
Misunderstanding the operational purpose of Output Back-Off

name: Free Space Transmission Loss
description: Calculation of Free Space Transmission Loss within satellite communication systems.
learning_objectives: Calculate Free Space Transmission Loss using standard parameters
Understand the factors affecting signal attenuation in free space
common_pitfalls: Neglecting frequency and distance variables in the calculation
Confusing free space loss with atmospheric attenuation

name: Received Carrier Power and C/N Ratios
description: Mathematical formulations and operational characteristics of Received Carrier Power (C) and Combined Carrier-to-Noise (C/N) ratios in bent-pipe transponders.
learning_objectives: Analyze mathematical formulations for Received Carrier Power
Calculate Combined Carrier-to-Noise (C/N) ratios in bent-pipe transponders
common_pitfalls: Incorrectly combining uplink and downlink noise ratios
Misapplying the bent-pipe transponder model equations

name: Satellite Circuit Interference
description: Analysis of operational characteristics regarding satellite circuit interference.
prerequisites: Received Carrier Power and C/N Ratios
learning_objectives: Identify sources of satellite circuit interference
Analyze the operational impact of interference on circuit performance
common_pitfalls: Confusing internal transponder noise with external circuit interference
Overlooking the cumulative effect of multiple interference sources
